title: A transaction left with an open sponsorship fails txBAD_SPONSORSHIP
pattern: BEGIN_SPONSORING_FUTURE_RESERVES without the matching END in the same transaction: every operation succeeds, then the transaction fails with txBAD_SPONSORSHIP and nothing it did is kept. Its fee is charged and its sequence number consumed. Readers that take operation results at face value record sponsorship that never happened.

hazards.placement: txBAD_SPONSORSHIP: a failed transaction whose operations report success
